# SnapDeck AI

> Turn photos and PDFs into flashcards instantly with on-device AI.

SnapDeck AI is an iOS app that uses Apple Intelligence to generate flashcards from photos of textbooks, lecture notes, handouts, and PDF documents. All processing happens on-device — no internet required, no cloud uploads, completely private.

## Key Facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone 15 Pro and later, iOS 26+)
- AI: Apple Intelligence (on-device Foundation Models)
- Privacy: 100% on-device, no data collection, no accounts required
- Price: Free (3 decks/month), Premium one-time purchase for unlimited use (no subscription)
- Developer: 12F ApS (https://12f.dk/)
- Website: https://snapdeck.12f.dk/

## Features

- Snap a photo of any study material to create flashcards
- Import PDFs for flashcard generation
- Type or paste text manually
- Interactive study mode with flip cards
- Progress tracking (know it / review it), study streaks, XP and stats
- On-device AI — no internet connection needed
- Dark mode; app available in 39 languages
- No accounts, no tracking, no data leaves the device

## Blog

Study advice for students, published at https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/ (RSS: https://snapdeck.12f.dk/feed.xml).

- [How to study from bullet-point lecture slides when they say nothing](https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/studying-from-bullet-point-slides/) — study-tips, 2026-07-28. Most lecture slides are thin on substance — fragments, keywords, bullet points that look like notes but aren't.
- [How to memorise a lot of material fast — the method that works](https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/memorise-material-fast/) — memory-science, 2026-07-23. Explains why re-reading material fails at building long-term recall and shows a concrete four-step system: turn dense material into questions, use self-testing instead of review, create flashcards from photos of your notes, and repeat the recall loop.
- [How to study when you're too tired to focus properly](https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/how-to-study-when-tired/) — study-tips, 2026-07-23. When you're exhausted, not all studying is useless — but the methods that work at full energy don't work when you're running on fumes.
- [How to study when you can't focus for more than ten minutes](https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/focus-when-you-cant/) — study-tips, 2026-07-23. Focus isn't a switch you flip — it's a muscle that tires fast under pressure.
- [Failed an Exam? What Now: A Step-by-Step Recovery Guide](https://snapdeck.12f.dk/blog/failed-exam-what-now/) — study-tips, 2026-07-23. Walks through what to do in the days after a bad exam result: resist the emotional spiral, diagnose whether the problem was knowledge, technique, or timing, and build a recovery plan that targets the real issue.
